meta.title: The Machine: Manhattan
meta.disclaimer: All identities, records, incidents, and scores are fictional. Educational simulation only.

evidence.summary: Office device appears downtown outside normal hours
evidence.detail: Twenty-four week baseline has no comparable visit

evidence.summary: Requests physical drive and confirms deadline
evidence.detail: Message: "Midnight. Local copy first, then the account clears."

evidence.summary: New shell account receives test deposits
evidence.detail: Three transfers below internal review threshold

evidence.summary: Encrypted archive staged for timed transfer
evidence.detail: Outbound bundle contains synthetic ledger fragments

evidence.summary: Vehicle idles near the service ramp
evidence.detail: Fourteen-minute dwell with engine running

evidence.summary: Instructions reference lower loading entrance
evidence.detail: Message: "Keep the corridor clear. Van takes the lower ramp."

evidence.summary: Service-corridor badge cloned outside shift
evidence.detail: Two denied entries followed by a successful entry

evidence.summary: Work order includes cable ties and opaque sheeting
evidence.detail: Items inconsistent with assigned maintenance call

evidence.summary: Sender pressures subject to bring the only local copy
evidence.detail: Message: "Bring the drive. Do not upload it."

evidence.summary: Heads downtown after being summoned by a supervisor alias
evidence.detail: Tap-in aligns with Nassau Street arrival window

evidence.summary: Credentials rejected after an unrequested password reset
evidence.detail: Synthetic audit log: five failed sign-ins

evidence.summary: Reports a ledger discrepancy to a private address
evidence.detail: Attachment hash matches the altered grant ledger

evidence.summary: Three short stops around the same block
evidence.detail: Synthetic device pings form a surveillance loop

evidence.summary: Coordinates and exit timing exchanged
evidence.detail: Message: "West door. 22:25. Two minutes, then gone."

evidence.summary: Cash purchase of a prepaid handset
evidence.detail: Corner electronics receipt; device activated 16:03

evidence.summary: Courier account receives an unusual cash-equivalent transfer
evidence.detail: $640 equivalent from a dormant sender

evidence.summary: Subject enters the projected event radius
evidence.detail: Synthetic camera hit at W 22nd Street

evidence.summary: Usual train replaced by a late westbound bus
evidence.detail: Route diverges 2.8 km from twelve-week baseline

evidence.summary: Unrecognized sender asks whether she closes alone
evidence.detail: Message: "Still closing by yourself tonight?"

evidence.summary: Closing shift extended by forty minutes
evidence.detail: Staffing schedule edit places subject near event window

evidence.summary: Dispatch route converges on projected event point
evidence.detail: Synthetic AVL coordinate within 340 m

evidence.summary: Anonymous medical call redirects ambulance unit
evidence.detail: Caller disconnects before triage completes

evidence.summary: Unknown sender claims to know the unit route
evidence.detail: Message: "Unit 14 will reach the circle first."

evidence.summary: Shift swap places subject in Unit 14
evidence.detail: Change approved by a newly created account

evidence.summary: Same dark vehicle appears in two nonadjacent locations
evidence.detail: Synthetic plate token repeats behind subject

evidence.summary: Ride-share destination changed to Canal Street
evidence.detail: Destination entered after a cancelled subway trip

evidence.summary: Anonymous warning references a private archive visit
evidence.detail: Message: "The Canal files were never yours to read."

evidence.summary: Meeting added by an unknown external address
evidence.detail: Invitation title: ARCHIVE RETURN / 23:00

evidence.summary: Asks coworker to cover the closing shift
evidence.detail: Message: "Running late—can you lock up?"

evidence.summary: Bus route passes event radius
evidence.detail: Route is common for this subject

evidence.summary: Last-minute table cancellation near Columbus Circle
evidence.detail: Manager handles a routine cancellation
